note: Verified reason for every branch of concerto-core src that the unit suite covers but the oracle corpus does not (task P2-11). Keyed <file>:<line>:<branch> as in coverage-gaps.json; bin/coverage-gaps.js merges these into it and reports stale or missing entries. Line numbers are those of the frozen reference and the identical workspace src/.

categories.stub-only: The unit suite reaches the branch only through a sinon stub, a sinon stub instance or a monkey-patched method, forcing a state no object built through the public API can be in. Handed to P2-10 (accordproject/concerto-rust#54).
categories.internal-only: Reached only by calling an internal (@private) method or constructor directly, with arguments no public operation passes. Handed to P2-10 (accordproject/concerto-rust#54).
categories.plan-owner-decision: Reachable through an exported API with no stub, but only through a call the oracle deliberately does not record (an introspection constructor) or cannot yet encode (a DecoratorFactory). Recording it is a change to the oracle design, not implemented here. Handed to accordproject/concerto-rust#94 by the plan owner.
categories.unrecordable: Reachable through the public API, but only by a call this oracle cannot record by design: an async result, a function argument, a Symbol, a model manager tainted by addDecoratorFactory/updateExternalModels, or an operation whose effect is on the file system. Not stub-only and not P2-10 work: covering it needs a change to the oracle (fixture schema or recorder). Handed to accordproject/concerto-rust#94 by the plan owner.

With real objects Property.validate() (called first) already rejects a missing type (`Type ... is not defined`, `No type ... in namespace`, checked against src with a relationship to a missing local, imported and unregistered type), and the other-namespace lookup throws rather than returning null. src/introspect/scalardeclaration.ts:89:6.reason: ScalarDeclaration.process()'s `type = null` fallback for an unknown $class. ModelFile builds a ScalarDeclaration only for the six scalar $classes (modelfile.ts fromAst switch; anything else is rejected), so the only way in is the exported ScalarDeclaration constructor called directly with an AST that has no scalar $class, as test/introspect/scalardeclaration.js does. The oracle deliberately records no introspection constructors (a declaration built outside its model file is also not encodable: nonplain:declaration-not-in-modelfile). Recording it would mean adding a ScalarDeclaration.new op and an encoding for the parent ModelFile; handed to accordproject/concerto-rust#94.
